title: Average complexity of the OR function
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real $p$ with $0<p<1$, the minimum average query cost of a zero-error randomized decision tree computing the OR function on $n$ independent signs, each equal to $1$ with probability $1-p$, is $\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(1-p)^k$.
